reports.title: ATRenew Inc. Reports Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company currently expects its total revenues to be between RMB7,780.0 million and RMB7,880.0 million, representing an increase of 24.4% to 26.0% year-over-year. This forecast only reflects the Company's current and preliminary views on the market and operational conditions, which are subject to change.

desk.headline: Revenue up 25% to RMB6.45bn, slightly above estimates; net income up 54%; Q4 revenue outlook of 24–26% growth
results: Revenue rose 25% to RMB6.45bn, a little above the RMB6.41bn estimate, led by online sales of used electronics.
Operating income rose 58% to RMB190.7m as fulfilment and marketing costs grew more slowly than sales.
Net income rose 54% to RMB139.5m; adjusted EPS was RMB0.99 per ordinary share, up from RMB0.68.
Buybacks were about US$6.6m in the quarter, with about US$28.6m left under the programme; cash and similar funds were RMB1.94bn.

guidance.summary: ATRenew expects Q4 revenue of RMB7.78–7.88bn, up 24.4–26.0% from a year ago. It gives no profit guidance.

points: The finance chief linked higher own-sales gross margin (14.4% from 13.4%) to door-to-door collection, refurbishment and channel mix.
Revenue from refurbished products rose about 35%, and direct retail sales to consumers grew about 44%.
Multi-category recycling service revenue grew 38%; the company plans 10 theme stores in 2026 and more categories.
Overseas product revenue rose about 150%, with roughly RMB1bn expected for 2026.
For 2027, management flagged weaker new-phone shipments as a risk to the supply of used devices.
call.source: Call highlights — GuruFocus via Investing.com, 19 Nov 2026

watch: Whether Q4 revenue lands in the RMB7.78–7.88bn range through the Double 11 season.
Inventory levels, which are up about RMB240m since year end.
Progress on the planned Hong Kong listing and the 60% profit payout plan.
